CITY OF SOUTH PASADENA
  CITY COUNCIL CLOSED SESSION
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA

  City Manager’s Conference Room, Second Floor, City Hall
  1414 Mission Street, South Pasadena, CA 91030

  Wednesday, February 21, 2018, at 6:30 p.m.
  The public may comment on Closed Session items prior to the City Council recessing to Closed Session.
  In order to address the City Council on Closed Session items, please complete a Public Comment Card.
  Time allotted per speaker: 3 minutes. The City Council will convene in Open Session at 7:30 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER:  Mayor Richard D. Schneider, M.D.

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Michael A. Cacciotti, Robert S. Joe, and
  Diana Mahmud; Mayor Pro Tem Marina Khubesrian, M.D.;
  and Mayor Richard D. Schneider, M.D.

PUBLIC COMMENT PERIOD FOR CLOSED SESSION ITEMS ONLY
(Time limit is three minutes per person)
The City Council welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council
by completing a public comment card and giving it to the Acting Chief City Clerk prior to the
meeting. Pursuant to State law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on
the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2).

CLOSED SESSION AGENDA ITEMS

A. Initiation of Litigation

  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – INITIATION OF LITIGATION, Pursuant to
  Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(4):

  Number of Cases: 1

minutes_text:
CITY OF SOUTH PASADENA
  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
  Amedee O. “Dick Richards” Jr. Council Chamber
  1424 Mission Street, South Pasadena, CA 91030
  Wednesday, February 21, 2018, at 7:30 p.m.

  ACTION AGENDA
  The Action Agenda is an unofficial summary of action taken at the meeting.
  It is posted before the minutes are approved and will be replaced by the approved minutes.

1.  Closed Session Announcements – The City Council received briefings and provided
  direction to staff regarding the agendized Closed Session Items, but did not take any
  reportable action.

2. Presentation by the Pasadena Humane Society on Available Animal Adoptions

3. Merchant Minute – Aro Latin/Radhika Modern Indian

4. Councilmembers Communications

5. City Manager Communications - Reported on items made under public comments at previous
  meetings regarding
  Consideration of prohibition of smoking near corridors around schools
  Flag maintenance and review of policy

6. Reordering of and Additions to the Agenda- None

7. Approve the City of South Pasadena Prepaid Warrants Nos. 201775 through 201826 in the
  amount of $194,871.09; General City Warrants Nos. 201828 through 201917 in the amount of
  $630,163.58; Payroll dated February 9, 2018, in the amount of $612,294.18.
  Motion – Cacciotti; Second – Joe
  Vote 5-0
  Staff Contact: Finance Director David Batt (626) 403-7250

8. Receive and file the Monthly Investment Reports for December 2017.
  Motion – Cacciotti; Second – Joe
  Vote 5-0
  Staff Contact: Finance Director David Batt (626) 403-7250

9. Approve the Discretionary Fund request by Councilmember Cacciotti designating $250 for
  the purpose of contributing to the purchase of bicycle lights for the Metro Bicycle Friendly
  Business District’s Bike San Gabriel Valley Pilot Program.
  Motion – Cacciotti; Second – Joe
  Vote 5-0
  Staff Contact: Finance Director David Batt (626) 403-7250

10. Appropriate from General Fund Reserves $5,000 to Account #101-1020-1022-8040 Elections
  Advertising, $45,000 to Account #101-1020-1022-8170 Elections Professional Services, and
  $50,000 to Account #101-2010-2013-8160 Personnel Legal Services; Receive and File the
  Mid-Year Financial Report for Fiscal Year 2017-18.
  Motion – Cacciotti; Second – Joe
  Vote 5-0
  Staff Contact: Finance Director David Batt (626) 403-7250

City of South Pasadena  Page 1
 Action Agenda  South Pasadena City Council  February 21, 2018

11. Accept a bid dated January 30, 2018, from American Asphalt South, Inc., for the
  construction of the Mission Street Improvement Project; Reject all other bids received;
  authorize the City Manager to enter into a contract for an amount not-to-exceed $231,075.
  Motion – Cacciotti; Second – Joe
  Vote 5-0
  Staff Contact: Staff Contact: Acting Public Works Director Rafael Casillas (626) 403-7240

12. Accept a $30,000 grant from the County of Los Angeles for the creation of a homelessness
  plan; authorize a Memorandum of Understanding with the San Gabriel Valley Council of
  Governments to use grant in hiring a regional consultant to develop homeless plan; authorize
  the City Manager or her designee to execute related agreements.
  Motion – Cacciotti; Second – Joe
  Vote 5-0
  Staff Contact: Management Analyst Karen Aceves (626) 403-7256

13. Authorize the City Manager to apply for a California Department of Transportation Sustainable Communities
  Grant in the amount of $250,000 to fund a City of South Pasadena Active Transportation Plan.
  Motion – Cacciotti; Second – Joe
  Vote 5-0
  Staff Contact: Staff Contact: Principal Management Analyst Margaret Lin (626) 403-7236

14. After holding a Public Hearing and receiving public testimony and hearing any objections or
  protests to the procedures for abating brush and native vegetation fire hazards identified in
  Resolution No. 7545, adopt by motion an order directing the abatement of hazardous
  vegetation.
  Motion – Cacciotti; Second – Mahmud
  Vote 5-0
  Staff Contact: Fire Chief Paul Riddle (626) 403-7300

15. Read by title only for first reading, waiving further reading, and introduce an Ordinance
  entitled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of South Pasadena, California,
  amending Chapter 21A (Skateboards and Skateboard Parks) of the South Pasadena
  Municipal Code” regarding procedures and requirements for proper usage of the Skateboard
  Park, in accordance with California State Assembly Bill 1146 (AB 1146) Skateboard Parks
  and CA Health and Safety Code Section 115800.
  Motion – Khubesrian; Second – Mahmud
  Vote 5-0
  Staff Contact: Community Services Director Sheila Pautsch (626) 403-7360

16. Authorize staff to enter into negotiations with San Pascual Stables, LLC, for the operation of
  the San Pascual Stables.
  PULLED FROM THE AGENDA. NO ACTION TAKEN.
  Staff Contact: Community Services Director Sheila Pautsch (626) 403-7360

17. Award a multi-year contract to West Coast Arborists Inc. for Urban Forestry Services and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the attached Services Agreement in an amount not-to-
  exceed $375,000.
  Motion – Mahmud; Second – Joe
  Vote 5-0
  Staff Contact: Acting Public Works Director Rafael Casillas (626) 403-7240

City of South Pasadena  Page 2
 Action Agenda  South Pasadena City Council  February 21, 2018

18. Approve the City of South Pasadena’s default energy mix of fifty percent option renewable energy for the Clean
  Power Alliance of Southern California, formerly known as Los Angeles Community Choice Energy.
  Motion – Mahmud; Second – Cacciotti
  Vote 5-0
  Staff Contact: Acting Public Works Director Rafael Casillas (626) 403-7240

  2/22/2018
  Date  Desiree Jimenez, CMC
  Acting Chief City Clerk
